sloka: सज्जं द्युतिकरं श्रीमदभिषेकपुरस्कृतम् ।पाण्डुरश्च वृषः सज्जः पाण्डुरोऽस्वश्च सुस्थितः ॥२-१५-११॥
transliteration: sajjaṁ dyutikaraṁ śrīmadabhiṣekapuraskṛtam ।pāṇḍuraśca vṛṣaḥ sajjaḥ pāṇḍuro'svaśca susthitaḥ ॥2-15-11॥

translations.english: A bull and a horse both pale white and a majestic elephant in rut worthy of royal ride stood waiting.
